key_impacts: Harbor walls overtopped by meteotsunami waves
Shoreline and city streets flooded near Ludington
Damage to shoreline homes and public boat docks
Water intake pumps impacted at a nearby hydroelectric facility
Water level fluctuations up to 2 m outside harbor (0.5 m at harbor gauge)
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; shoreline homes and boat docks were damaged; pumps were impacted.
NWS received reports of 2 m water level fluctuations outside the harbor; the harbor gauge recorded up to 0.5 m.
